toegepas.rede_vinder: 'in die tyd van' is wordy; 'van ... tot' carries the same date range more naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'in die tyd van 1220 tot 1300' is wordy where 'van ... tot' already marks a time span.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The date range stays attached to the capital in the same place, the protected 'hoofstad was die nedersetting op en onder Mapungubwe-heuwel' is untouched, and nothing is claimed differently.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The past participle belongs at the end of the main clause, before the relative clause, in natural Afrikaans word order.
toegepas.fout: 'het ook gegeld op plekke' places the participle before its prepositional phrase in an English-like order.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Verb-final 'het ook op plekke gegeld waar...' is the natural Afrikaans order and matches the lesson's opening sentence, with the same people, places and meaning.

toegepas.na: wat tot vandag toe oorgebly het
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'tot vandag toe oorgebly' is the idiomatic way to say something has survived until now.
toegepas.fout: 'wat vandag oorgebly het' reads loosely as 'remained today' rather than 'survived until today'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'tot vandag toe oorgebly het' is the fixed Afrikaans expression for having survived until now, and the protected 'deel van die getuienis' stays intact.

laat_vaar.blok: Klipmure by die koning se woonplek
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The adverb 'daarbo' (up there) is written as one word.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'daar bo' (up there, on the hill) is correctly two words; 'daarbo' means 'above that' or 'more than that', so the proposal introduces an error and moves the meaning.

laat_vaar.voor: By Mapungubwe kon 'n mens die mag
laat_vaar.na: By Mapungubwe kon jy die mag
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The next sentence addresses the reader as 'jy', so using 'jy' here too keeps the pronoun consistent across the two sentences.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Generic ''n mens' followed by generic 'jy' is normal Afrikaans and echoes the block title, while the proposal creates the repetitive 'kon jy ... Jy kon sien'.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: With an abstract noun such as 'leierskap', 'waarby' is more correct than the place word 'waar'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Leierskap waar' uses the place word 'waar' with an abstract noun, a common anglicism.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a [begrip] definition, and swapping the relative particle changes its wording beyond a plain spelling fix (and 'waarby' may not be the best choice), so the writer has to fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The compound preposition is written 'bo-op' (hyphen at the vowel clash).
